title: Derived native open restriction commutes with tensor
statement: For a native open tensor datum s, nativeDerivedTensor on the ambient scheme followed by nativeOpenPull is naturally isomorphic to the product of nativeOpenPull with itself followed by nativeDerivedTensor on the open scheme.

proof.text: Restrict the quotient to the full subcategory of native acyclic-test K-flat ambient complexes. It localizes at quasi-isomorphisms. Convert their predicate to NativeIsKFlat; restriction preserves this predicate by s.

Use the natural derived tensor model isomorphisms on two ambient K-flat complexes and on their restrictions. Insert the cochain restriction comparison and the exact derived functor factorization between them.
Whiskering along the product localization is fully faithful. Take the preimage of the assembled natural isomorphism to obtain the comparison on arbitrary derived inputs.
